title: Configure DO Spaces client and presigned URL generation for file uploads
acceptance_criteria: S3 client configured with DO Spaces endpoint (nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com)
Presigned POST URL generation implemented for secure file uploads
Presigned GET URL generation for reading files with expiration
Bucket and region configurable via environment variables (DO_SPACES_*)
Generated URLs expire after configurable duration (default 15 min for uploads, 1 hour for reads)
completion_summary: Installed @aws-sdk/client-s3 and @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner. Created lib/storage/client.ts (S3 client configured for DO Spaces endpoint, lazy singleton). Created lib/storage/presigned.ts (getPresignedUploadUrl, getPresignedDownloadUrl, deleteObject, buildTenantKey).
